issues: Add or explicitly support the periodic report examples in R108—bibliographic records with holds and items not checked out for X days. The general report-writer and canned-report requirements do not ensure these reports can be produced with the necessary fields and criteria.

Address the analytics requirement in R113: the set does not explicitly require statistics for understanding or predicting patron behavior and material use. Either add this capability or clarify which existing reports satisfy it.

Add transaction filtering and reporting by date/time, workstation, and staff member from R149. `transactions-history-and-aggregation` covers hour and terminal grouping, but not staff or the requested date/time criteria.

Add or explicitly include the named operational reports missing from the set: overdue items with patron contact information (R201) and claims-returned items (R204). Generic query/report tools do not guarantee these report definitions or their required fields.

Add collection age and price-value reporting by call number (R206, R207), or document that the report writer supports the required fields and calculations. Current collection-value reporting does not specify the call-number breakdown or collection-age report.

Clarify R112: the referenced attached fine-grained-report specification is not provided or traceably represented in the requirements. Supply and map that specification, or establish that R112 is not an in-scope requirement.

Remove or consolidate duplicated requirements: `report-output-formats-and-delivery` and `export-and-excel-quality` repeat Excel-compatible and pivot-table output (and export quality); `vendor-integration-apis` repeats the API/file-transfer integration scope in `enterprise-integration-and-opac-interaction`; and `report-selection-criteria-display` repeats criteria display already required by `report-writer-features`. Preserve any unique details when consolidating.

Consolidate repeated batch-operation safety requirements across `item-transfer-batch-utility`, `purging-and-weeding-utility`, and `efficient-batch-update-safety` (including previews, permissions, performance, and revert/confirmation behavior), or make the cross-cutting requirement clearly non-redundant.

Consolidate the repeated snapshot requirements for bills and transaction data across `transactions-history-and-aggregation`, `real-time-and-historical-reporting`, and `snapshot-bills-and-last-circulation` (R374, R379, R380), retaining the distinct last-circulation and renewal rules.
